description: The salary before tax needed to take home a set amount a month or a year, after income tax, National Insurance, student loan and pension, at this tax year's rates - the take-home calculator's own sums, so the two agree to the pound. Use for 'what do I need to earn to take home £3,000 a month'.

pensionMethod.description: How the pension is paid: sacrifice (off pay before tax and NI), netPay (before tax, NI still charged) or reliefAtSource (from pay after tax, the provider adds basic-rate relief). Defaults to sacrifice.

pensionPercent.description: % of salary paid into a pension, 0 to 100. Defaults to 0.

per.description: Whether takeHome is a month's or a year's.

postgradLoan.description: Also repaying a Postgraduate Loan. Defaults to false.

scotland.description: Scottish income tax rates. Defaults to where they live, from Settings - false if not said.

studentLoanPlan.description: Undergraduate student loan plan, if any.

takeHome.description: The take-home wanted, after tax, NI, student loan and pension, in pounds.

name: calculate_salary_for_take_home
title: Salary for a Take-Home Target
